summary: Timed builds of every policy/framework.json module (cold and edited DMD and LDC, compiler peak RSS, templates, linked bytes)
why: Each framework module's compile-time and compiler-RSS budgets are provisional placeholders until measured. After a run that counts as evidence, `python3 tools/framework_budgets.py apply <out>/framework-builds.json --receipt <receipt>` sets each provisional key to the measured value plus headroom (seconds x1.5 of the median, rounded up to 0.01 s; RSS x1.25, rounded up to a MiB) and drops it from 'provisional'; that policy change is committed and reviewed separately. Template instances use measure_builds' method own-library-and-probe/2, which also counts each module's own -lib compile. The measurement runs in a worktree at d153fd1 (all 15 modules' probes and budgets, the -lib template fix and --framework-builds) with its own native prefix.
report_to: policy/framework.json via framework_budgets.py apply; the requester
